=== start-server ===
#!/bin/bash

# Start server
if [ "$1" = "-r" ]; then
    echo "Starting Development server with reload."
    exec uvicorn main:app --reload
else
    echo "Starting Production server."
    exec gunicorn -w 1 -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker main:app --bind=0.0.0.0
fi

observation.command: cd /workspace/apps/data_store_backend && ls && find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.py' | head -40 && echo "=== start-server ===" && cat scripts/start-server.sh 2>/dev/null
